Subject: Weekly MAP Checkpoint — Acceptance heatmap & owner updates

Hi Samir / Erin —

Quick weekly checkpoint for the MAP and the live trial acceptance plan. See attached heatmap (MAP_AugWeek1_v2.xlsx) and the live runbook link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxyz/Map-Acceptance. Highlights:

- Gating status (green/amber/red):
  - Functional evals: green (basic generation + tool calling)
  - Latency SLO: amber (99th percentile currently ~220ms; target <200ms)
  - Data residency: amber (we have initial VPC peering in dev, needs prod confirmation)
  - Quality regressions: green for summary tasks, amber for long-form extraction

Action summary (owners & ETA):
- Finalize acceptance test dataset (owner: Samir) — due 2026-08-06
- Confirm production VPC peering window (owner: Erin) — due 2026-08-05
- Run long-load quantization pass and report token-level regressions (owner: Rishi) — due 2026-08-07
- Executive acceptance review (owner: Diego) — scheduled 2026-08-10 10:00 PT

Open blockers:
1) One of your red-team scenarios triggers slight hallucination on table recs at >1k tokens — need the final dataset to reproduce.
2) Production networking sign-off for the private endpoint (Aurelia compliance).

Please confirm the acceptance dataset scope (full patient de-id payload vs sampled summaries) — if you can drop the dataset by EOD Thursday that lets Rishi run the quant tests and get us back under the latency SLO with batching/kv-cache tweaks.

Attachments: MAP_AugWeek1_v2.xlsx (heatmap + owners)

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

> Quick weekly checkpoint for the MAP and the live trial acceptance plan.

We can commit to delivering the acceptance dataset by end of day 2026-08-06, but scope note: the dataset will exclude raw patient identifiers — we'll provide de-identified full payloads and a separate sampling of original synthetics for edge-case repro. I'll attach the acceptance checklist we use internally (see attachment).

Two asks from Aurelia:
- Please ensure the acceptance criteria explicitly include:
  1) 99th latency < 200ms for API-only routes with batching disabled for the single-request baseline.
  2) F1 > 0.86 on the entity extraction eval (we'll provide labels).
- For the networking window, we need confirmation of the planned downtime/peering window no later than 2026-08-05 17:00 PT.

I'll upload our dataset link tomorrow AM.

Regards,
Samir Chaudhry
Product Ops — POC Lead, Aurelia Health

Marissa / Diego — quick technical update before the demo prep.

Summary: quantization pass on the current model build (8-bit dynamic) produced a regression for prompts >1,200 tokens. Root cause appears related to block-sparsity interactions in the custom kernel at long sequence lengths. Actions I will take this week:

- Run an extended quantization validation set across sampled long prompts (owner: Rishi) — ETA 2026-08-07 18:00 PT.
- If regressions persist, fallback to mixed-precision (16-bit) on the long-prompt route for the demo and run a cost delta estimate (owner: Rishi) — ETA 2026-08-08.
- Request temporary GPU quota bump on our dedicated pool for weekend runs (owner: Diego to approve + infra ticket).

Log excerpt (sanitized):
> ERROR [2026-08-05 02:44:12] kernel_exec: mismatch at block 3 for seq_len 1536 — re-run with full precision.

Will attach the quant run summary once complete. This is actionable and not blocking acceptance if we can: (a) get the dataset on 8/6 and (b) agree to the mixed-precision fallback for very long prompts during the demo.

-Rishi
Principal ML Engineer | Redwood Inference
